title: The box

posts.caption:
First look at the box every DAUR pair arrives in.

An espresso leather finish with DAUR in brass on the lid. Inside, each pair of men's leather shoes is packed by hand in cream tissue, with the Manifest Card on top. Delivery across Pakistan, Cash on Delivery.

Design render. Real photos when the first kits are made.

Save this post and compare it with the real box when Drop 01 lands.
